channel.title: Developer Diary · Masortim
channel.description: Notes on projects, tools, and decisions made while building.

item.title: An event calendar that checks its sources
item.description: Conference Tracker shows upcoming and past events without hard-coding dates that change over time. Stack: Obsidian · JavaScript. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/conferences

item.title: Portablizer: a portable install without surprises
item.description: Behind the generic repository name Test is Portablizer, a project for creating and maintaining a portable PyCharm installation on Windows. Stack: Python · Windows. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/Test

item.title: A catalogue and analysis of UAVs
item.description: The project gathers UAV technical specifications and turns them into structured data for exploration and comparison. Stack: Python · Streamlit. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/UAV_classification

item.title: Lectures as a graph of concepts
item.description: Lecture Graph Vault structures lecture material to be read as text and explored as a network of links. Stack: Obsidian · JavaScript. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/Lecture-Graph-Vault

item.title: Measuring shapes in an image
item.description: A Python experiment combines image processing and geometry, moving from pixel contours to shape measurements. Stack: Python · OpenCV. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/Measuring-the-area-of-the-figures

item.title: An arcade in text mode
item.description: A console take on Arkanoid, exploring how game physics and level state fit into a compact C program. Stack: C. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/Arkanoid

item.title: From text PRN to CSV
item.description: The converter turns column-oriented PRN text into CSV rows ready for further processing. Stack: C · C++ · C#. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/prn_to_csv_converter

item.title: Tic-tac-toe against the computer
item.description: A small Windows Forms app turns a familiar game into an exercise in UI state and turn-taking. Stack: C# · Windows Forms. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/TicTacToe

item.title: One greeting, many languages
item.description: This repository gathers tiny greeting programs so that language syntax can be compared without the distraction of larger examples. Stack: Multi-language. Repository: https://github.com/Masortim/hello_world
